title: schemas/auth.py — Pydantic v2 auth schemas
scope: Five Pydantic v2 BaseModel classes. LoginRequest: username (str), password (str min_length=1). TokenResponse: access_token (str), token_type (Literal['bearer']), role (str). UserCreate: username (str min_length=1 max_length=100), password (str min_length=8), role (Literal['STAFF','VERIFIER','SUPERVISOR']). UserRead: id (int), username (str), role (str), is_active (bool); ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). UserUpdate: is_active (bool | None = None), role (str | None = None), new_password (str | None = None) — all optional for partial PATCH. No project module imports.
